# vista.css

> A Windows Vista "Aero" design system in pure CSS: translucent glass windows,
> glossy controls, Segoe UI. No JavaScript. Markup-compatible with 98.css and
> XP.css.

vista.css turns semantic HTML into a faithful Windows Vista Aero interface. It
ships as one self-contained stylesheet (`dist/Vista.css`) with icons inlined as
data URIs and no bundled fonts. The window frame and taskbar are translucent
`backdrop-filter` glass, so they need a background behind them.

- Requires `backdrop-filter` (all current browsers; `-webkit-` prefix included).
- No build step to consume: link the CSS, or `npm install vista.css`.
- One theme today: `aero`. Add others under `themes/<name>/`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install and usage.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): full component/markup reference, theming variables,
  and contributor conventions.
- [components.json](components.json): machine-readable component manifest with
  copy-paste markup.
- Live docs: https://nicholaicascio.github.io/vista-css/

## Components

- Window: `.window` › `.title-bar` (`.title-bar-text`, `.title-bar-controls`),
  `.window-body`, `.status-bar` › `.status-bar-field`.
- Window controls: `button[aria-label="Minimize|Maximize|Restore|Help|Close"]`.
- Buttons: `button`, `.default`, `.active`, `.focused`.
- Fields: `input[type=text|password|email|search|url|tel|number]`, `textarea`,
  `select`; helpers `.field-row`, `.field-row-stacked`.
- Checkbox / radio: `input[type=checkbox|radio]` plus an adjacent `<label>`
  (the label draws the control).
- Tabs: `menu[role=tablist]` › `button[aria-selected]`, `[role=tabpanel]`,
  `.justified`.
- Group box: `fieldset` › `legend`, `.group`.
- Tree view: `ul.tree-view`, `.has-container`, `.has-collapse-button`,
  `.has-connector`; collapsing via native `<details>`/`<summary>`.
- Progress bar: `[role=progressbar]` › `div`; `.animate`, `.marquee`,
  `.paused`, `.error`.
- Scrollbar: `.has-scrollbar` on the scrolling container.
- Menus: `ul[role=menubar]`, `ul[role=menu]`, `li[role=menuitem]`; `.can-hover`,
  `.has-divider`, `[aria-disabled]`, `[aria-haspopup]`.
- Toolbar: `.toolbar`, `.toolbar-divider`, `button[aria-pressed]`.
- Balloon tooltip: `[role=tooltip]`; `.is-top`, `.is-left`, `.is-right`.
- Taskbar: `.taskbar`, `.start-orb`, `.taskbar-tasks`, `.taskbar-button`,
  `.taskbar-button-icon`, `.taskbar-button-text`, `.taskbar-tray`, `.tray-clock`.
- List view: `table.list-view`, `.highlighted`, `.indicator` (`.up`),
  `.has-shadow`.
- Search box: `input[type=search]`, `.searchbox`.
- Spinner: `.spinner`, `.loader`, `.animate`.

## Themes

- `dist/Vista.css`: Aero, the default. Translucent glass frame.
- `dist/Vista-Basic.css`: Vista Basic. Opaque frame, solid title bar, no blur.

## Theming

All visuals are driven by CSS custom properties on `:root`. Override `--surface`,
`--accent`, `--glass-tint`, `--glass-blur`, `--button-face`, `--field-border`,
`--progress-bar`, `--taskbar-bg` and friends to recolor. See AGENTS.md for the
full list.
